mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always reported and its current low level (0.12%) indicates a low-interest-rate environment that compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as FEDFUNDS is available without condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is reported (which is always), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240, it signals high inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 240), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in employment (PAYEMS), signals robust economic growth that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase occurs in > 60% of cases without positive 20-day returns, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (indicated by housing starts HOUST > 1200), the S&P 500 tends to have positive forward returns as the economy is strong but the central bank is not yet tightening aggressively.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1200), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.15%, it signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.15), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250, it signals a strong housing market that supports economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST > 1250), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5), or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
